basic_details.job_title: IISER Bhopal Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Biological Sciences at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal (IISER Bhopal) has advertised one Project Scientist post for the BIRAC-funded INSACOG wastewater surveillance project, an 18-month engagement at Rs. 67,000 per month plus 20% HRA. Applicants need a doctoral degree in life sciences, or in computational sciences or bioinformatics, or in bioinstrumentation, with at least 60% aggregate marks and five years of research experience. Applications go by email to [email protected] by 10 November 2026.

qualification.details: Experience in developing and running scientific instruments. Familiarity with anaerobic culturing and bioreactors. Preferably next-generation sequencing data analysis for genome and metagenome. Programming, script writing in Perl or Python or C, database construction, and development of AIML tools. Managerial skills, including project management, report writing, and coordination with other institutions. | Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording of the post.

how_to_apply: Combine the cover letter, CV, referee details and certificates into a single PDF.
Send the PDF by email to [email protected].
Write the subject line exactly as: Application for the post of PS – INSACOG 2026.
Mention clearly the position you are applying for.
Send the email on or before 10 November 2026.

Detailed CV, including a photograph, email ID, phone number, educational/professional qualifications, master's thesis title and a brief description of the work done, and details of research experience, if any.
Names of two referees, with their current position, address and email ID.
Copies of all academic marksheets and certificates, in chronological order from Class 10 onwards.
Proof of qualification of a national-level examination (if applicable).
important_instructions: Only shortlisted applicants will be informed. No interim correspondence will be entertained. Queries about the post, the nature of the project or the suitability of a candidature can be sent to Dr. Vineet K. Sharma, Professor, Department of Biological Sciences, at [email protected] or +91-755-269-1401. The notice also says interested candidates may apply online through a link on the institute's website; the detailed procedure it prints is the email application above.

content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Project Scientist at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal
Expansion of INSACOG Wastewater surveillance of SARS-CoV-2, Emerging Pathogens and Antimicrobial Resistance through Genomic-based methods

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian Nationals can apply. The qualification and experience for the Project Scientist post are as follows. Experience: At least five years of experience in research and development during or after Ph.D in microfabrication and scientific instrumentation in industrial and academic institutions, and in sciences and technology organizations. Age: The candidate should be under 40 years of age as of 1 December 2026. Age relaxation is granted as per the rules of the Government of India; the notice prints no further detail. Experience in developing and running scientific instruments. Familiarity with anaerobic culturing and bioreactors. Preferably next-generation sequencing data analysis for genome and metagenome. Programming, script writing in Perl or Python or C, database construction, and development of AIML tools. Managerial skills, including project management, report writing, and coordination with other institutions. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Doctoral degree in life sciences OR Computational sciences or Bioinformatics OR Bioinstrumentation from a recognised university or an equivalent institution, with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks (relaxation will be given as per the GOI guideline)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs. 67,000/- per month + @20% HRA. The project runs for 18 months, and the notice states that all positions are purely temporary and coterminous with the project. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Project Scientist Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the role as follows: the candidate will engage in anaerobic culturing of microbes and metagenomes; perform and coordinate sample collection activities; maintain a systematic data repository; manage experimental data; prepare reports; collaborate with other institutions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Bhopal Project Scientist
content_sections.text: Combine the cover letter, CV, referee details and certificates into a single PDF. Send the PDF by email to [email protected] . Write the subject line exactly as: Application for the post of PS – INSACOG 2026. Mention clearly the position you are applying for. Send the email on or before 10 November 2026. Cover letter. Detailed CV, including a photograph, email ID, phone number, educational/professional qualifications, master's thesis title and a brief description of the work done, and details of research experience, if any. Names of two referees, with their current position, address and email ID. Copies of all academic marksheets and certificates, in chronological order from Class 10 onwards. Proof of qualification of a national-level examination (if applicable).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted through a comprehensive application screening process, as outlined in position-specific guidelines. Shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview before a screening committee, and the notice says shortlisted applicants will be asked to appear for an online interview. The names of shortlisted candidates and the interview dates will be published on the IISERB website. The interview committee's decision is final, and no further correspondence is entertained.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice says the deadline may be extended for exceptionally qualified candidates, and that positions remain open until filled.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted applicants will be informed. No interim correspondence will be entertained. Queries about the post, the nature of the project or the suitability of a candidature can be sent to Dr. Vineet K. Sharma, Professor, Department of Biological Sciences, at [email protected] or +91-755-269-1401. The notice also says interested candidates may apply online through a link on the institute's website; the detailed procedure it prints is the email application above.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Scientist vacancies are there at IISER Bhopal?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 1 Project Scientist position in the Department of Biological Sciences.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application deadline is 10 November 2026, though the notice says it may be extended for exceptionally qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IISER Bhopal Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: A doctoral degree in life sciences OR Computational sciences or Bioinformatics OR Bioinstrumentation from a recognised university or equivalent institution, with at least 60% aggregate marks, plus at least five years of research and development experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The candidate should be under 40 years of age as of 1 December 2026, with relaxation as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Scientist?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 67,000/- per month + @20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email a single PDF with the listed documents to [email protected], with the subject line "Application for the post of PS – INSACOG 2026".

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted by application screening and the shortlisted ones are invited for an interview before a screening committee; the notice mentions an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Project Scientist job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the position is purely temporary and coterminous with the 18-month project.

faq.question: Q9. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 67,000?
faq.answer: The notice gives the remuneration as Rs. 67,000/- per month + @20% HRA, so HRA at 20% is stated in addition to the amount.

faq.question: Q10. Is travel allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
